CREATE RULE "_RETURN" AS
    ON SELECT TO public.vw_discovery_recipes DO INSTEAD  SELECT r.id,
    r.name,
    r.category,
    r.cuisine_type,
    r.meal_types,
    r.description,
    r.ingredients,
    r.image_count,
    r.total_time,
    r.is_vegetarian,
    r.last_cooked_date,
    r.created_at,
    r.finished_dish_index,
    COALESCE(v.vote_count, (0)::bigint) AS vote_count,
    r.supper_suitable,
    r.servings
   FROM (recipes r
     LEFT JOIN ( SELECT recipe_votes.recipe_id,
            count(recipe_votes.recipe_id) AS vote_count
           FROM recipe_votes
          WHERE (recipe_votes.vote = 1)
          GROUP BY recipe_votes.recipe_id) v ON ((r.id = v.recipe_id)))
  WHERE ((r.is_discoverable = true) AND (r.is_ready = true) AND (r.deleted_at IS NULL));

CREATE RULE "_RETURN" AS
    ON SELECT TO public.vw_recipe_matches DO INSTEAD  SELECT recipe_id,
    count(recipe_id) AS vote_count
   FROM recipe_votes
  WHERE (vote = 1)
  GROUP BY recipe_id;

triggers: CREATE TRIGGER canonical_recipe_content_guard BEFORE UPDATE ON public.recipes FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION guard_canonical_recipe_content()
functions: text, internal, smallint, internal, internal, internal, internal
internal, smallint, text, integer, internal, internal, internal, internal
internal, smallint, text, integer, internal, internal, internal

BEGIN
    IF OLD.canonical_content IS NOT NULL AND (
        NEW.canonical_content IS NULL OR
        ((NEW.source_url IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.source_url OR
          NEW.raw_metadata IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.raw_metadata OR
          NEW.ingredients IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.ingredients OR
          NEW.servings IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.servings OR
          NEW.canonical_content IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.canonical_content) AND
         NEW.canonical_content->>'contentRevision' IS NOT DISTINCT FROM OLD.canonical_content->>'contentRevision')
    ) THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Canonical recipe content requires guarded publication' USING ERRCODE = '23514';
    END IF;
    RETURN NEW;
END
